question: If the mean proportional of P and 242 is 88, then find the value of P.5766
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between two values is the square root of their product.

So, P × 242 = 88²

P = (88 × 88) ÷ 242

P = (88 × 4) ÷ 11

P = 8 × 4 = 32

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Mean proportional between P and 242 = 88

**Formula Used:**

Mean proportional of a and b = √(a × b)

 

 Product of Means = 88 × 88

 

 Product of Extremes = P × 242

 
 P

 
 88

 :
 ::

 
 88

 :

 
 242

⇒ √(P × 242) = 88

Squaring both sides:

⇒ P × 242 = 88²

⇒ P = (88 × 88) ÷ 242

⇒ P = (88 × 4) ÷ 11

⇒ P = 8 × 4

⇒ P = 32

**∴ The correct answer is 32.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Mean Proportional

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given by √(a × b).

Third Proportional

The third proportional to numbers a and b is c, such that a : b :: b : c. It is calculated as c = b² ÷ a.

Fourth Proportional

The fourth proportional to numbers a, b, and c is x, such that a : b :: c : x. It is calculated as x = (b × c) ÷ a.
